name: Hot Honey Chicken Sweet Potato Bowls

components.name: Hot Honey Chicken

ingredients.name: Raw boneless skinless chicken breast (target about 920 g cooked)

steps: Slice raw chicken into equal strips, coat with olive oil, part of the hot honey and measured seasonings.
Arrange chicken on a second lined tray and roast until golden and its thickest pieces reach 74 C, typically 18-28 minutes.

components.name: Roasted Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.name: Raw sweet potatoes (target about 1200 g cooked)

steps: Heat oven to 205 C. Scrub sweet potatoes, cut in half lengthwise and coat lightly in 15 ml oil. Place cut sides down on a baking tray and roast 40-55 minutes until tender, depending on size.
Cool sweet potatoes enough to handle and portion around 300 g cooked per meal if actual yield allows; add roughly 230 g cooked chicken per portion.

components.name: Toppings
steps: Top each portion with mozzarella, but pack yogurt sauce, pickled onions and honey drizzle separately for fresh assembly after reheating.

components.name: Yogurt Sauce
steps: For sauce, combine yogurt with lemon juice, garlic powder, salt and parsley; keep refrigerated.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.

Creator post lists 230 g COOKED chicken and approx 300 g COOKED sweet potato per bowl. Raw quantities (1230 g chicken, 1400 g potato) are UNHANGRY estimated raw equivalents, not published raw weights; weigh after cooking and revise. Published creator macros ~600 kcal, 65 g protein, 50 g carbs, 13 g fat, but our ingredients differ and per-serving nutrition is recalculated.
Planning: Original creator pan-cooks chicken; this is UNHANGRY OVEN ADAPTATION, not a claimed original oven method. Fresh finishing required.
Freezer: chicken and sweet potatoes freeze; chilled yogurt and pickled onions should be packed separately
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
